rationale: The preceding sentence chooses n with positive measure for F_n, and the next displayed integral subtracts 2^{-n} times mu(F_n). Subtracting the characteristic function of all F would not yield that integral and need not preserve the required domination; the indexed set F_n is the proof's intended set.

The infimum must range over the tail functions f_m. Using f_n makes the bound variable m vacuous, contradicts the following inequality against inf_{m>=n} of the upper integrals, and does not construct the monotone tail-infimum sequence needed for liminf.
